from, a preposition construed only with the genitive. Its primary use is with the genitive of place from which someone or something moves or goes out: whence it is transferred to other expressions, in which origin, kind, cause or source of men or things, whether falling under the senses or not, or time from which something happens or has happened or will happen, is indicated.
